request.spec:
A plan may instead run monthly on a day of the month (1 to 31): the plan dates are that day in
every month from the start's month, a day beyond the month's length falling on its last day, dates
before the start left out (PLAN_ADDED ends day=<day> end=<date> instead of every=).
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A plan may instead run monthly on a day of the month (1 to 31): the plan dates are that day in
every month from the start's month, a day beyond the month's length falling on its last day, dates
before the start left out (PLAN_ADDED ends day=<day> end=<date> instead of every=).

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A plan can now run monthly on a day of the month, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests in the spec.

**Monthly plans**
- **Form:** each person's plan form has a new "Or day of month" field (`plan-form-day`), next to the existing "Every N days" field. A plan uses one or the other. The server refuses a day outside 1–31, both fields filled, or neither.
- **Dates:** the plan's day in every month from the start's month on. A day past the month's end falls on the last day (day 31 gives Feb 28, Apr 30). Dates before the start are left out.
- **Audit:** `PLAN_ADDED … start=<date> day=<day> end=<date>` for a monthly plan; every-N-days plans still write `every=` as before.
- **Storage:** a new migration, `V72__plan_month_day.sql`, adds a `month_day` column and lets `every_days` be empty. The date logic is in the new `PlanDates.java`, which `GeneratePlans` now uses. A monthly plan's row reads "monthly on day N".

**A second fix, outside the request.** Scenario 1 failed in older code, not in the plan feature. When the sheet was viewed "as of" an earlier date, a claim still showed a deferral that was only made later. To fix it:
- A new `claim_defer_log` table (`V73__claim_defer_log.sql`) records each deferral with the sheet's today when it was made.
- The as-of view of claims now shows the last deferral made by that date.
- Cloning a sheet copies the new log.
- Claims deferred before this change have no log entry, so they keep showing their deferral in every as-of view.

Only the claims list uses the log. Other as-of figures that depend on whether a claim is deferred still read its current deferral.
